name: Lunar regolith and compacted pad approach

variants.note: Foot-worn approach to the habitat and pad, marked by decals.
A few broad light patches radiating from a real crater.

approval.note: W0 design proposal for Claude review; no art, material ID, painter or live placement approval.

story.lore: Reuse one lunar surface through crater rims and habitat approaches.

todo: Purpose: Reuse one lunar surface through crater rims and habitat approaches.

Visual brief: Calm violet-grey dust with sparse rounded stones and broad ejecta-tone patches; compacted tracks stay shallow. No grass, liquid shore or Earth-style weather pattern outside the pressure shell.
Widths and size: 24 art px per cell; 2/3-cell paths and a wider authored pad apron, with no automatic slope walking.
Implement after review: choose authored anchors, exact collision and approved variant art; these cell envelopes are layout proposals, not measured sprite bounds.
Keep exterior pressure status explicit in scene metadata; this surface cannot confer low gravity, oxygen use or suit damage.
Implement after review: the schema owner supplies the runtime material/pair block and stable ID only after the design is accepted; no executable painter is asserted here.
Sizing basis: material/edge extent is specified in 24-art-px logical cells; no opaque-object scale class is assigned. Review grain, width class and derived face height instead.
Lighting: Upper left; material-specific ramps and directional planes; no mirror-only relighting.
